verdict.rationale: The included registered-agent service receives service of process, legal notices and state correspondence, and scans served legal documents the same day so customers have more time to respond. That is faster than the usual 6-business-hour scan window, so legal mail gets effective priority. Generic automation rules exist, but no evidence shows they can detect or flag government senders like the IRS. missing for 10: explicit flagging or tagging of IRS/government mail in the regular mailbox, urgent alerts or notifications for compliance mail, documentation that automation rules can target sender types, independent or hands-on corroboration.
